summary: Tested the 3 items from this round: (1) OrgStructure Edit-Setting/Edit-Team stale-form race fix, (2) 18 new FK indexes, (3) meetings date field_validator. Backend: 19 pytest tests (18 pass). All 8 garbage date strings + missing/wrong-type date now return 422; all 5 valid ISO formats create + persist correctly; all 18 expected FK indexes exist in Postgres; backend startup clean. Frontend: race-condition repro executed with network timing instrumentation. IMPORTANT: the race fix initially appeared BROKEN because /app/frontend runs `vite build && vite preview` (NO hot reload) — the served bundle predated the fix. After `supervolctl restart frontend` (rebuild) the fix is CONFIRMED WORKING for both Setting and Team: refetch GET /org/structure completes BEFORE the modal closes, reopened Edit form shows the just-saved value, and re-saving does not revert. Found one NEW CRITICAL unrelated bug: creating/editing a Team from the UI fails with 404 whenever Supervisor is left as 'None' (UI sends supervisor_user_id: "" -> asyncpg InvalidTextRepresentationError -> global 404 handler). NewMeeting UI create with a valid date works (no regression). Dashboard loads. All TEST_ data created was cleaned up, plus the orphaned 'TEST_ Supervision with Connor Repro' meeting from a prior round.

critical.issue: supervisor_user_id="" (exactly what OrgStructure's inline 'Add Team' form always sends when no supervisor is picked) is passed raw into an INSERT on a native uuid column -> asyncpg InvalidTextRepresentationError -> caught by server.py global handler -> 404 {"detail":"Not found"}. Team creation from the UI is completely broken. Fix: sup_id = data.supervisor_user_id or None (same pattern already used for manager_user_id in create_setting), or coerce empty strings to None in TeamCreate via a validator.

Same empty-string UUID bug: editing a team with Supervisor='None' returns 404 'Not found' and the rename is silently lost (modal stays open, red 'Not found' banner). Lines routers/org.py:293-296 use data.supervisor_user_id raw.

minor.issue: Mapping InvalidTextRepresentationError to a bare 404 {"detail":"Not found"} masks genuine bad-input bugs (this is exactly how the team bug hid). Consider 400/422 with a field-specific message, and log the offending value.

ui_bugs.component: OrgStructure – inline Add Team form / Edit Team modal
ui_bugs.issue: Sends supervisor_user_id: "" instead of null when Supervisor='None', causing the 404 above; team create/edit unusable without selecting a supervisor. Also the inline Add Team input has no data-testid.
Backend failure shows only a generic top-of-page red 'Not found' banner; the Edit Team modal shows no inline error, so the user cannot tell which field failed.

integration_issues.issue: frontend package.json start = 'vite build && vite preview' — there is NO hot reload. Source edits are invisible until `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` (≈60s rebuild). The Edit-Setting race fix measurably still had the OLD behaviour (modal closed 4ms after PUT, refetch landed 2s later, reopened form stale) until I rebuilt. Main agent MUST restart frontend after every frontend edit before self-testing.

action_items: CRITICAL: coerce empty-string UUID fields to None in routers/org.py create_team (line 272/275) and update_team (line 291-296) — or add a Pydantic validator on TeamCreate.supervisor_user_id. Team create/edit from the UI is currently broken.
Audit other routers for the same raw empty-string-into-uuid pattern (grep for data.<x>_id passed to a uuid column without 'or None').
Restart the frontend (supervisorctl restart frontend) after any frontend change — no hot reload in this repo.
Optionally return 400/422 with a field name instead of a bare 404 for InvalidTextRepresentationError so bad-input bugs are not masked.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/org.py create_setting/update_setting correctly normalise manager_user_id with `or None`, but create_team/update_team do not do the same for supervisor_user_id — inconsistency is the root cause of the 404.

OrgStructure.js refreshData()/await ordering is correct and verified: refetch resolves before setEditingSetting(null)/setEditingTeam(null); the reopen-stale-form and silent-revert defect no longer reproduces.

utils/apiCache.cachedGet has no in-flight request dedupe; two concurrent GETs to the same URL can resolve out of order (last-response-wins). Not observed as a defect after the rebuild, but worth hardening since fetchData can be triggered concurrently by mount + mutation.
OrgStructure.js is 930 lines — above the 700-line guideline; consider splitting Settings/Teams/Users sections.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (setting + team race fix pass, meeting create + dashboard pass; team create/edit-without-supervisor fails)

rca_of_the_issue: Race fix false-negative RCA: /app/frontend is served from a production Vite build (`vite build && vite preview`), and the frontend process had been running since before OrgStructure.js was edited, so the browser executed the pre-fix bundle. Instrumented timeline on the stale bundle: PUT 200 at t=12.512s, modal closed t=12.516s, refetch GET landed t=14.507s, reopened form showed the OLD name and re-saving reverted the row in the DB. After rebuilding: PUT 200 t=12.489s, refetch GET t=14.503s, modal closed t=15.004s, reopened form showed the new name — fix confirmed. Team 404 RCA: routers/org.py:272/293 pass data.supervisor_user_id straight into a native-uuid column; the UI's teamForm initialises supervisor_user_id to "", asyncpg raises InvalidTextRepresentationError on '', and server.py's exception handler converts it to a generic 404, so the mutation silently fails.
